summary: Catheter Precision filed an 8-K reporting the results of its September 30, 2026 annual meeting, including stockholder approval of an amendment to its 2023 Equity Incentive Plan adding 5,000,000 shares and a one-time repricing of outstanding options. All options with exercise prices above Fair Market Value were reset to $0.152 per share, the NYSE American closing price on the approval date, without changing share counts, vesting, or expiration. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms apply; this is a routine compensation and governance filing. Watch for dilution from the expanded plan and option overhang.
